g.text: CampusClaw Target POST Events and History
bind this message, resume segment or interrupt target
validate dependencies and accept user event
short transaction: recheck, append; persist stop intent if interrupt
start / resume only; interrupt is handled by DB polling
[Output belonging to the bound request scope]
publish after commit in Session order
Confirmed idle closing and database interrupt handoff
enqueue idle, then complete this response
query fixed snapshot in committed internal order
No public executionId, runId or sequence.
Credentials belong only to the required in-memory execution.
Do not hold a DB transaction while calling models, tools or network writers.
Never broadcast unrelated Session events to this response.
A closed response does not cancel accepted execution.
History repairs uncertainty; never replay the POST automatically.
Interrupt delivery uses durable stop intent and per-instance polling.
Redis is deferred; no sticky routing or instance forwarding.
